title: Final Answers
description: Essential Criteria: Provide correct identification of reactions that violate conservation laws and state the specific laws violated.

title: Conservation Laws
description: Important Criteria: Clearly explain the conservation laws relevant to each reaction, including lepton number, charge, baryon number, and energy.

title: Allowed Reactions
description: Important Criteria: Correctly identify which reactions are allowed without violations.

title: Clarity of Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: Provide clear and concise reasoning for each violation or allowance, enhancing understanding.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid misidentifying allowed reactions as violating conservation laws.
